title: "Embracing the promise of a radiant future, for I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope. (Jeremiah 29:11) Grateful for God's boundless love, confident that He who began a good work in me will bring it to completion, ensuring a future filled with wealth and abundance. (Philippians 1:6)"
